---
title: "Astryx controls"
---

Astryx controls are the interactive building blocks for notebook forms,
filters, command panels, and data views. They synchronize Python state through
normal traitlets and can be composed inside Lumino layouts or other Astryx
containers.

## Form controls

```python
import anylumino as al

order_form = al.AstryxFormLayout(
    {
        "symbol": al.AstryxTextInput(value="AAPL", label="Symbol"),
        "quantity": al.AstryxNumberInput(value=100, label="Quantity", min=1),
        "side": al.AstryxSegmentedControl(
            ["Buy", "Sell"],
            value="Buy",
            label="Side",
        ),
        "routing": al.AstryxSelector(
            ["Smart", "Primary", "Dark"],
            value="Smart",
            label="Routing",
        ),
        "urgent": al.AstryxCheckbox(value=False, label="Urgent"),
    }
)
```

Use `.value` to read synchronized state:

```python
order_form["symbol"].value
order_form["quantity"].value
```

Use `observe(..., names="value")` when another widget should react to edits:

```python
status = al.TextWidget("Ready")
symbol = al.AstryxTextInput(value="AAPL", label="Symbol")

def on_symbol_change(change):
    status.value = f"Symbol: {change['new']}"

symbol.observe(on_symbol_change, names="value")
```

## Selection controls

Astryx selection widgets cover small option sets, searchable option sets, and
multi-value tokenized filters.

```python
filters = al.AstryxStack(
    {
        "symbol": al.AstryxTypeahead(
            ["AAPL", "MSFT", "NVDA"],
            value="AAPL",
            label="Symbol",
        ),
        "fields": al.AstryxTokenizer(
            ["Bid", "Ask", "Last", "Size"],
            value=["Bid", "Ask"],
            label="Fields",
        ),
        "density": al.AstryxSegmentedControl(
            ["Compact", "Standard", "Expanded"],
            value="Standard",
            label="Density",
        ),
        "metric": al.AstryxSelector(
            ["Latency", "Volume", "Fills"],
            value="Latency",
            label="Metric",
        ),
    },
    gap=3,
)
```

`AstryxTypeahead`, `AstryxTokenizer`, and `AstryxCommandPalette` currently use
static search sources. Query text and open-state changes are sent as widget
messages; selected item ids are synchronized through `.value`.

## Buttons and actions

Button-like widgets use callbacks because a click is an event, not a persistent
value.

```python
status = al.TextWidget("Ready")

submit = al.AstryxButton(
    "Submit",
    variant="primary",
    callbacks=[lambda _button: setattr(status, "value", "Submitted")],
)

actions = al.AstryxCommandPalette(
    [
        {"id": "refresh", "label": "Refresh", "auxiliaryData": {"group": "Data"}},
        {"id": "export", "label": "Export CSV", "auxiliaryData": {"group": "Files"}},
    ],
    value="refresh",
    width=420,
)
```

## Tables

`AstryxTable` is the data-grid control for notebook data views:

```python
orders = al.AstryxTable(
    rows=[
        {"order_id": "O-1", "symbol": "AAPL", "qty": 10, "status": "NEW"},
        {"order_id": "O-2", "symbol": "MSFT", "qty": 5, "status": "PARTIAL"},
    ],
    columns={"order_id": "Order", "symbol": "Symbol", "qty": "Qty", "status": "Status"},
    row_key="order_id",
    selects="multiple",
    sortable=True,
)
```

Leave `selects=""` for no checkbox column, use `selects="single"` for one
selected row, or use `selects="multiple"` for checkbox multi-selection.

```python
orders.append_row({"order_id": "O-3", "symbol": "NVDA", "qty": 1, "status": "NEW"})
orders.update_row("O-2", {"qty": 7, "status": "FILLED"})
orders.remove_row("O-1")
orders.set_rows(next_order_snapshot)
```

## Themed controls

Wrap related controls in `AstryxTheme` to apply a shared brand identity:

```python
brand = al.AstryxBrand(
    "desk",
    **{
        "color-accent": ("#0057b8", "#79b8ff"),
        "color-background-card": ("#ffffff", "#111827"),
        "radius-container": "8px",
    },
)

panel = al.AstryxTheme(
    {"filters": filters, "submit": submit, "orders": orders},
    brand=brand,
    gap=3,
)
```
